verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Shopify supports third-party payment integrations, but with an extra 1% transaction fee. Shopify Markets lets merchants sell to multiple markets with per-market pricing from one store, which implies multi-currency support without saying so outright. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of third-party gateway selection and supported providers, explicit documentation of charging in multiple currencies, and hands-on corroboration of both.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can choose among third-party payment gateways and charge in multiple currencies when the built-in option doesn't fit

citations.quote: Shopify charges additional 1% per transaction for 3rd party payment integrations.
Sell to multiple markets, all from a single store
